title: The workshop
sections: No apprentices left alone with your car, and the person who quotes the job is the person who does it.

Urs Kessler

Owner, technician

Thirty years on the tools. Diesel injection, and anything electrical everyone else has given up on.

Mira Halter

Technician

Diagnostics and hybrids. Trained on the systems most independents send away.

1. 1994

    One ramp, rented

    Urs took the lease on half of what is now the workshop and worked on whatever came through the door.

  2. 2008

    The second bay

    Took the rest of the building. Added the ramp we still use for everything heavy.

  3. 2019

    Hybrids and diagnostics

    Retrained rather than turn work away, which is why we can still take the cars other garages send on.
